data.creator_notes:
Fixed mistake with the name. 
And here is my second monster girl. I took a couple of creative liberties with the source material to make it fit the story line I had planned. This bot is more token heavy by a bit. I wanted to try something a bit bigger than normal with a story line. Through testing it seems like it's worked out well. 

I test my bots on Mars Mixtral. Your mileage may vary based on what model you use.
Still have a concept I am working on that I hope to have released soon. Until then let me know how Alma works or doesn't work or If you see something I should fix.

From this bot forward I now generate my images using Stable diffusion web ui. I use Pony Diffusion(yes that's what's it's called. I know. But it's good lol.) I didn't quite have the hardware before to do what I wanted but now I do. so expect images more like this from now on. If and when I go back and refresh/update previous characters I may generate new images for them and include the originals in the gallery. 

If you have any requests or comments feel free to leave a review or email me at direwolf7@tutanota.com
